reviews.rationale: Attributable net loss rose from about $5bn (2024) to about $39bn (2025), as reported and confirmed by the FT. That is a dramatic year-over-year increase. A noncash charge drove most of it, but under the contract's measure reported losses still clearly mounted. Supported.
